title.zh: 【Ethena 向币安存入 1.286 亿枚 ENA，价值约 2433 万美元】
title.en: 【Ethena 向币安存入 1.286 亿枚 ENA，价值约 2433 万美元】

current_state.zh: Ethena deposited 128.6 million ENA (about $24.33 million) to Binance, apparently as part of Binance's buyback of the 217.5 million ENA stolen in its breach so it can complete Proof of Reserves.
